item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Lines per folio: 5; 4 on fol. 1b.
Double numbering of the folios, from 1 to 113 and from 210 to 322 (200 being represented by a "xx" sign. 300 by "xxx").
Proofread twice (1 zhus dag; yang zhus dag).
The name "bcom ldan ral gri" in the colophon, as well as lemmata seem to have been written in color in the original. The latter are not very legible in the reproduction.
